verdict.rationale: The evidence describes local FIDO2/PIV/OTP key-management tools, an Entra ID bulk-enrollment script, and a browser WebAuthn demo page. None of it documents a sandbox or test environment isolated from production data, for example a test tenant or dry-run mode for the Entra provisioning tool. The FIDO2 demo is a WebAuthn playground for trying out keys, a related but different feature, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
